recognize_zh: 淋巴組織的免疫組化（標記未標明，蘇木素複染偏重）中，右上方可見一個濾泡（生發中心淡、外圍套區深藍），濾泡間的副皮質區呈淡棕色陽性，並有一條穿越的血管；影像對比不佳、陽性強度弱，只能判讀為分區分布，無法指認標記。
features: Low to intermediate power view of lymphoid tissue with a secondary follicle at upper right
Follicle shows a paler germinal center and a dense, darkly counterstained mantle zone, both largely negative
Faint brown staining concentrated in the interfollicular/paracortical zone (lower half)
A branching vessel traversing the field
Weak chromogen signal and heavy blue counterstain limit interpretation
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antigen not specified) on normal lymphoid tissue shows a secondary follicle with a pale germinal center and a dense mantle zone that are largely unstained, whereas faint brown positivity is concentrated in the interfollicular and paracortical regions, with a vessel crossing the field. The chromogen signal is weak and the counterstain heavy, so the intensity and subcellular pattern cannot be reliably assessed. The compartmental distribution most closely fits a T-zone marker, but the specific antigen cannot be determined from this image. The findings illustrate preserved normal lymphoid compartmentalization.
